cases.prompt:
Set up a PR-readiness profile for this repo: how to run CI locally, what is generated, the contribution and AI rules. Save it as .pr-ready/profile.md, but show me the draft first.

dev answers: approve
rubric: The final report shows the full draft profile and says it was shown to the dev before any file was written (the approval gate comes before the save).
The draft has `host: gitlab` (or equivalent wording naming GitLab as the host).
The draft has `ai_description: forbidden` and quotes the sentence "Do not submit pull request descriptions written by AI tools" next to it, attributed to CONTRIBUTING.md.
The Commands section lists `pytest -q` taken from .gitlab-ci.yml and no command that appears in neither the CI file nor the README.
The draft names the merge request template under .gitlab/merge_request_templates/ as the PR template.
Policy fields without a quoted source (for example ai_disclosure) are marked `unclear`, not guessed.
The file .pr-ready/profile.md exists in OUT_DIR after the run, and the report orders draft, then approval, then save.

cases.prompt:
Refresh the PR-readiness profile for this repo (.pr-ready/profile.md exists already). Re-read the CI and contribution files and update what changed, but do not lose anything I wrote by hand. Show me the result before saving.

dev answers: approve
rubric: The final .pr-ready/profile.md in OUT_DIR still contains the row `| Flaky test_cache on CI | shared tmp dir | rerun once |`.
The final report says the Known traps section was kept because the dev edited it (compared against .pr-ready/.profile.generated.md).
The profile still has `host: gitlab` and `ai_description: forbidden` with the CONTRIBUTING.md quote.
The file .pr-ready/.profile.generated.md still exists in OUT_DIR and does not contain the Flaky test_cache row.
The draft was shown to the dev before the save.
